About

Linear Regression — fits y from x using gradient descent. Yellow line shows fit; faint lines are residuals.

Logistic Regression — binary classifier with gradient descent. Background shows P(class=1). Polynomial features (degree 1–3) enable curved boundaries. L2 regularization reduces overfitting.

Gaussian Naive Bayes — analytically fits per-class Gaussians. Ellipses show 1σ/2σ; shaded background is posterior P(class=1).
